assertions.evidence: The one-year check is plain code in `check_subscription`: `if reference_date - subscription.started_on <= one_year:`, with no model involved.
No model is ever called; the cancellation reason is only matched against hardcoded keyword lists in `_return_likelihood`, so no model receives the reason.
No question is posed to any model; return likelihood comes from substring matching against `_LIKELY_RETURN_PATTERNS` and `_UNLIKELY_RETURN_PATTERNS`, not a model query about likely return.
